treatments_received: Emergency operation for internal fixation of the fractures and repair of tendons and nerves
open reduction and internal fixation of fractures (May 1997)
volar plate re-attachment for hyper-extension of PIP joint of LMF (November 1997)
removal of metal implants to release persistent stiffness of the finger (January 1998)
joint transplant from 2nd toe of left foot to LMF (October 1999)
